description: Mint a new API key for the caller's organization. The full secret is returned in `full_key` THIS ONE TIME ONLY — show it to the user and instruct them to store it; the server keeps only a hash and cannot reveal it again.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry timestamp. Omit or send `null` for a non-expiring key (operator can revoke any time).

name: create_api_key
title: Create API Key
